column2: Stats from training (on top of Absorption)
Back to Third-Rate. Your shadow from your last life blocks the way. Get past it.
The second shadow. A little tougher than last time.
The shadow of your third life knows all your habits. Drop them.
The fourth shadow. Beat it and the Fist King's seat comes into view. But the road doesn't end there.
The fifth shadow. By now even shadows are stubborn. Be ready for a long fight.
The last shadow. Beat it and the cycle of rebirth ends. After that, the road leads to the Underworld.
Press when the ring shrinks. Raises Might and HP
Press when your breath is fullest. Raises Ki and HP
Deflect (F) the moment the wooden arm comes in. Raises HP and Agility
Keep balance on the post. Each press tips you right; leave it and you tip left
Strike when the heated iron sand jumps (fast)
Press when the ki has circled your body and is full
The demon in your heart takes form. Win to raise all stats a lot
Hold out under the great bell (keep it centered, like Horse Stance)
Lift the thousand-pound iron when the ring is smallest
Press when the ki has made a full circuit of your body
Step on the floating stone the moment it flashes (fast)
Steady your breath on the cloud lotus of the Sky Palace (all stats)
Take blows like water, let them flow, and strike back. Wide deflect window; each deflect stores a current that powers Rebound Palm.
Current: +1 per deflect (max 3). Z Rebound Palm grows with Current
A 0.8s parry stance. If hit, you deflect and counter automatically
Leaves a water vortex ahead for 3s. Keeps pulling nearby enemies and wears down their balance
The ground becomes a lake. For 3s a vortex drags every nearby enemy to the center, then a water pillar launches them skyward
An unbreakable diamond body. While attacking you can't be staggered and take less damage. Slow, but every blow is heavy.
Diamond Body: no stagger while attacking, 30% less damage taken. Dash is a bit slower
For 6s nothing can push you, and damage taken is halved
Roar in a cone ahead. Enemies hit have their guard broken and are stunned for a long time
For 6s you become a golden giant: no stagger, half damage taken, fists deal 1.6x and shake the area around the target. You stomp as you grow
A fast flurry like scattered petals. Keep the combo going to stack petals; at full they burst into bloom.
Petals: +1 per hit within 1.2s (max 20). At 20, your next Z heavy blooms into an explosion
Eight unseen blows in a row
Dash through enemies leaving only a scent (invincible). 0.7s later your path bursts into petals
As if time stopped, you pierce through up to eight nearby enemies unseen. A beat later they're all cut at once (invincible meanwhile)
A palm wind like a dragon breaking the sky. Hold Z and release to fire a blast sized by the charge. A long-range poking style.
Dragon Charge: the longer you hold Z, the bigger the blast (up to 1.5s)
Dragon energy that pierces forward (hits every enemy)
Rise like a dragon with an uppercut (launches enemies)
A real dragon bursts from the ground, slams the enemy three times, then breathes forward
Ghostly feet that leave no shadow. Two dashes, chained air kicks, and critical hits from behind.
Ghost Shadow: 2 dashes, air combos, 1.6x damage when kicking from behind
Teleport behind the nearest enemy and kick (critical)
Leap up and kick six times like a whirlwind
A shadow clone appears by each nearby enemy and kicks it three times (you direct from where you stand)
A straight fist as fast as lightning. Each hit builds charge; at full, your next attack chains lightning that paralyzes everyone around.
Charge: +1 per hit (max 5). At 5, your next attack is chain lightning (paralyzes nearby enemies)
Zigzag like lightning (invincible, paralyzes enemies you pass)
Pick five nearby enemies and drop lightning on their heads (paralyze)
Your body turns into lightning and jumps between enemies seven times. Lightning falls at each touch, and at the end the sky splits
The fist of eight drunken immortals. Your stagger dodges blows on its own and punches come from odd angles. Weak guard.
Drunken Step: 25% chance to dodge attacks while moving or attacking. You take more damage when blocking
Stagger wildly for 3s, dodging 60% of attacks and countering each dodge
Roll forward, kicking up every enemy you pass
Curl up like a burning wine jar and bounce between enemies six times, exploding each time. Ends with a big burst of wine fire (invincible meanwhile)
The basic style everyone learns first. Three straight fists of Heaven, Earth and Man. Not flashy, but never sloppy.
Basic: no special mechanic, but steady blocks and deflects. Given by Elder Cheongun
Step in and drive a punch
Gather the ki of Heaven, Earth and Man into one fist for 1s, then strike once. Everything ahead goes flying
Only those who collect all five scattered manual fragments can learn it
A fist with no end and no beginning, where all styles return to one. Your foe's balance breaks before your hand lands.
Limitless: every hit wears balance twice as fast, and the deflect window is wide
Press your palms together and push. A black orb and a white orb spiral forward, hit enemies on the way, then collide at the end, pulling in nearby enemies as they burst
Draw a circle in place. Black and white orbs swirl around you out to 16 studs and back, dragging nearby enemies in front of you for one more hit
The world loses its color and a 30-stud Taiji forms underfoot. Enemies on it freeze. It spins, rises, flips and stamps down like a seal, then a wave of black and white passes once more
Defeat the Blood Demon, master of the Blood Cult, and his hand is yours
The demonic art of the Blood Cult's master. Blood ki gathers at your nails. What you cut heals you.
Lifesteal: heal 2% of damage dealt (max 1.5% of max HP per hit; per 1s up to 4%)
Become a blood shadow and pass through enemies (invincible)
Spread a sea of blood underfoot for 4s. It keeps cutting enemies inside, and each cut heals you
A giant Blood Demon rises behind you, tears enemies four times with its claws and roars. Then 8s of frenzy (speed x1.2, lifesteal x1.5)
Only those at Life & Death meet the nameless old man, in a corner at the end of the world nobody visits
The fist the Emperor of Heaven left on earth. Wherever it lands, heavenly swords follow. Above its wielder, the gate of heaven is always open.
Heavenly Might: every five hits a sword of light falls and strikes the area. Wide deflect window, balance damage x1.5
Drive swords of light down onto three nearby enemies
The gate of heaven opens behind you and a spear of light pours forward in a line
The sky opens and countless swords of light appear. A sword pierces each enemy, then a giant heavenly sword slams down and explodes
Defeat the Heavenly Demon, the last foe of the martial world, to learn his art in reverse
A fist that turned the Heavenly Demon's art against itself. Where it lands, weight becomes tenfold, and at the end a black sun rises to crush everything it pulls in.
Pressure: every six hits a gravity well opens at the target, pulling nearby enemies in and pinning them down. Enemies hit are briefly slowed
Open a gravity well ahead. For 1.2s it sucks nearby enemies to the center and crushes them
Become a thousand-pound weight and drop onto the nearest enemy. The ground caves in where you land
Tear the sky with your fist and raise a black sun. It lifts every nearby enemy into the sky, grinds them, then collapses inward and explodes
Only those at Limitless meet the Origin Sage of the Beyond Peak, at the edge of the sky
A fist from the moment the world began. Its wielder floats above the ground, and the final blow shatters the world like glass before it reassembles.
Creation: every four hits a crystal of light blooms and bursts at the target. All skill cooldowns 20% shorter, and you float above the ground
